chapter: Washington clubs, Louis Jordan and Sarah Vaughan, 1949-54
title: Pearl Bailey fills in for Billie Holiday at the 2011 Room
summary: When Holiday cancels, the manager gets Pearl Bailey, who is then asked to go to California.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: So it just so happened that Pearl Bailey was living in Washington then; although she was working around the country, she made her home in Washington. And at this particular time, she was on sort of a vacation, I guess you'd call it. So we found this out, and the manager very quickly got Pearl Bailey to come into the club. Well, Pearl Bailey, I think she made some sort of a pact with him that she would come in and work for Billie Holiday's two weeks, if at a later date she could have two weeks of her own.. And of course, this was quite agreeable -- and the manager of the club was caught in a bind, so he had no choice. It was a good deal anyway, because Pearl Bailey was very well liked in Washington, too.

So Pearl came and she worked these two weeks. While she was there, she got a telegram from her office, someone in California, that they wanted her to come out there. She never had been in California before. And at that particular time, there was no Johnny Carson or that type of show in California. As a matter of fact, I don't think all of the network shows actually were shown in California. What I'm speaking about is the fact that a lot of auditions for bigger things now are made on things like The Johnny Carson Show or The Merv Griffin
Show or something like that, when people are really getting ready to launch a big artist.
